message: インテリのジンクス
When we arrived at school, all the students were gathered in the hall for an impromptu morning assembly.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be that student teacher we heard about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did they ever go out of their way to do something like this just for a student teacher?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They haven't.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. In that case, there's probably another reason.」

name: Helena
message: 「Good day, everyone. Today, I'd like to introduce our student teacher, Sengen'in-sensei.」
Guided by Helena-san's voice, the figure of what appeared to be a woman stepped onto the stage.

name: Nanaka
message: 「See, just as I thought.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's so far away I can't really see her.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I'm Sengen'in. It's a pleasure to meet you.」
Having said that curtly, Sengen'in-sensei walked off the stage.

name: Helena
message: 「Her subject is mathematics. She'll be in charge of Class 2-B, so please be friendly and get along with her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She seems like a pretty strict teacher.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't you think her cool demeanor is kind of like Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
I hope she manages to get along with Misa, though.

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, that concludes our morning assembly. Study hard again today!」
I could clearly picture her giving a thumbs-up.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Helena-san has never taken the mic during a regular morning assembly before, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Only during the annual ceremonies, I think.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wonder if that teacher is getting special treatment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean she's such a brilliant teacher that they want to hire her directly at this academy?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, you wouldn't be happy getting put on the spot like that. Normally, anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'd be one thing if she were an attention seeker, but she didn't look the type~」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you think, Azel?」
Ah, she went off somewhere again.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's our next class again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mm, math.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Class is starting. Take your seats promptly; no private chatter will be permitted from this point on.」
Right from the start, she was a strict teacher.
